fields.description: Issue includes local columns and notices along with extensive advertising for Miami-area bars, restaurants, and services. Content highlights include a Sam Marley column addressing Miami hosting visiting Legionnaires, a political note about Glen May possibly running for governor, racing-related tips and promotions connected to local tracks, radio program schedules, and a letter to the editor concerning rent increases and housing costs in Miami.
